name: @studio/audio-probe
description: Measuring decoded audio, and nothing else: where a take really starts and stops (trim gate), and the envelope + beat grid a surface draws over a region. No node:, no filesystem, no process — which is why a BROWSER may have it. Split out of @studio/commands so k7's clip panel stops pulling a 13k-line node package in for 69 lines of arithmetic. Consumed as source.
